## Scope and source notes

Downloaded 27 original raw XML examples: 17 CAMT052 (account entries/balance-only in seven named countries plus three cashpool examples) and 10 CAMT053 (seven country examples plus three cashpool examples). All namespace001.02. Current CAMT053 CGI MIG v7.0 dated2026-09-09. 054 examples available reference-only. Landing reserves all rights; no open redistribution license established. Footer also has US/Australian-person website access restriction.

No open redistribution licence established. Consult the publisher before republishing originals.
